summary.description: Five lines max: needs Cassidy / done / blocked.

artifacts.description: Every file created or changed, absolute paths.

source.description: file:line, transcript path@timestamp, command + output excerpt, or URL

decisions.description: Only those a DRD/DADR, the board or a transcript records. Label anything else 'proposed:'.

action.description: The exact command or paste text Cassidy would run or send.

target.description: Card #, thread, PR, sheet range: the exact place.

proofs.description: Evidence records, one per proof requirement. Required for build jobs (BASELINE, BEHAVIOR, QUALITY; PERFORMANCE when the work claims speed or cost; SKILL when instructions change). Optional elsewhere.

id.description: BASELINE | BEHAVIOR | QUALITY | PERFORMANCE | SKILL, or a done-means criterion

tested_revision.description: commit sha, or the data snapshot/date

observed.description: what actually came back, quoted or summarized with numbers

blocker.description: required when NOT_RUN: the missing access, tool or dependency
